import re
p='/work/model.scad'
s=open(p).read()
# restore outer vector: echo(cadverify_spec=[...multiple args...]); -> echo(cadverify_spec=[[...]]); 
# current pattern: echo(cadverify_spec=[FIRST],[SECOND],...]); need to wrap
# Do: replace 'echo(cadverify_spec=[' with 'echo(cadverify_spec=[[' and final ']);' with ']]);' only on those lines
lines=s.split('\n')
out=[]
for l in lines:
    if 'echo(cadverify_spec=' in l:
        l=l.replace('echo(cadverify_spec=[','echo(cadverify_spec=[[')
        # add one more ] before );  (line ends with ']);')
        assert l.rstrip().endswith(']);')
        l=l.rstrip()[:-3]+']]);'
        # fix through_holes to measured: box->1, lid->3 ; simplest: drop the entry
        l=l.replace('["through_holes",0],','')
        out.append(l)
    else:
        out.append(l)
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
for l in out:
    if 'echo(cadverify_spec=' in l:
        o=l.count('[');c=l.count(']')
        print(o,c,l[:90])
